meaning: Saved copies of pieces of a website kept on your device. They help pages open faster the next time.
clues: It saves something to make things quicker later.
What it saves are parts of websites, like pictures and logos.
Your browser looks here first, instead of downloading the same picture again.
It can fill up over time, and you can clear it in your browser settings.
It has five letters and starts with C. It sounds like the word for money you can hold.
